# May UI

> Apple's design language as a React library — iOS/macOS shapes, real spring
> physics compiled to CSS linear(), a --may-* token layer, and no runtime
> dependencies beyond React. Published on npm as @adit_firdaus/may-ui.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/adit-firdaus/may-ui/blob/master/README.md): overview, install, the full tour
- [Getting started](https://github.com/adit-firdaus/may-ui/blob/master/docs/getting-started.md): install, provider-first configuration, first component, styling your own markup
- [Theming](https://github.com/adit-firdaus/may-ui/blob/master/docs/theming.md): token layers, light/dark, scoped themes, tint vs primary
- [Motion](https://github.com/adit-firdaus/may-ui/blob/master/docs/motion.md): generated linear() springs, the sliding-thumb system and useSlidingThumb, exit animations
- [Components](https://github.com/adit-firdaus/may-ui/blob/master/docs/components.md): the three families and where each shape lives

## Live

- [Examples gallery](https://adit-firdaus.github.io/may-ui/): composed app screens, adaptive phone→desktop
- [Storybook](https://adit-firdaus.github.io/may-ui/storybook/): every component with its props and states

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/adit-firdaus/may-ui/blob/master/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents — the gate, code style, commit format
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/adit-firdaus/may-ui/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): human contributor guide

## Package

- Install: `npm install @adit_firdaus/may-ui` (react and react-dom 19 are peer deps)
- Import: `import { Button } from '@adit_firdaus/may-ui'`; components carry React stylesheet resources
- Entries: `@adit_firdaus/may-ui` (adaptive), `/desktop`, `/mobile`
